![](images/0.jpg) ## Temperature Cycling Test Testing Test Condition: -55~+125°C, 1000 cycles - Standard: JESD22-A104C - Testing Condition: -55°C to 125°C (TCB), 1000 cycles - Objective: Determine the resistance of TIM to extremes of high and low temperatures, and its ability to withstand cyclical stresses - Sample size: 8 pcs samples. ![](images/0.jpg) - Ramp time: 15mins - Dwelling time @-55°C and 125°C: 5mins - Every cycle: 40mins ![](images/1.jpg) PTM7950 remain reliable up to 1000 cycles for thermal cycling test. ![](images/2.jpg) 业界领先的导热效能和长效稳定性 RTX 5060 TI 无双MAX使用霍尼韦尔PTM7950相变硅脂片 ![](images/0.jpg) RTX 5060 TI 无双MAX 3D理论性能 ![](images/0.jpg) ![](images/0.jpg) GEFORCE RTX 5060 Ti 无双MAX 本质上它依然是一片游戏显卡 它无法完全替代专业显卡 但它给你提供了另一个选择 毕竟这是目前银河系最强的单槽GEFORCE RTX。 Thank you!
